Description: Setting things on fire on purpose, at range, with your mind. Arson with extra steps.
Rank 5 does: Burning from your fire spells lasts 1 round longer.

Description: Making things colder than they want to be. Mostly their blood.
Rank 5 does: Your frost spells' slow lands on every solid hit (tier 2), not just great ones.
Rank 15 does: A great frost hit (tier 3) stuns the target for a round.

Description: Being the thing the safety manual warned you about.
Rank 5 does: Lightning spells arc to one more enemy nearby, for half the damage.

Description: Borrowing from the dead and the nearly dead. Mostly the nearly.
Rank 5 does: Necrotic spells heal you for 25% more of the damage they do.
Rank 10 does: A great necrotic hit (tier 3) leaves the target bleeding for 3 rounds.

Description: Shining things at people until they feel better or go blind. Sometimes both.
Rank 10 does: Your light spells' blinding lands on every solid hit (tier 2), not just great ones.

Description: Standing behind something invisible and hoping. It's more than most people get.
Rank 5 does: Your protection spells last 1 round longer.
Rank 15 does: Protection spells come back 1 round sooner.

Description: Lying, with lights. The audience loves it when it works, and loves it more when it doesn't.
Rank 5 does: What your illusion spells inflict lasts 1 round longer.
Rank 15 does: Illusion spells cover a wider area: one target becomes a plus of five tiles.

Description: Changing what things are made of, or at least how fast they're going.
Rank 5 does: What your transmutation spells do lasts 1 round longer.
Rank 10 does: Transmutation spells come back 1 round sooner.
Rank 15 does: Transmutation spells cover a wider area: one target becomes a plus of five tiles.

Description: The spells nobody films. They'd be keeping you alive, if anybody noticed.
Rank 10 does: Bad Feeling and other utility effects last 3 more rooms.
